data.narrative:
Aurora Innovation is a public-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised approximately $2.5B to date. The relevant peer universe consists of seven private companies in the same sector, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist within the narrowly defined Drones & Autonomous category.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable in this instance. The sector contains only five same-sector peers total, and filtering by stage, timing proximity, or comparable valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints—below the minimum threshold for reliable median-based triangulation. An all-sector median approach would introduce excessive noise and dilute relevance, rendering this method unsuitable for the target's specific circumstances.

Given the constraints of the available data, no triangulated valuation range can be defensibly derived at this time. The primary limitation is the thinly populated peer set within Drones & Autonomous. To support a credible valuation, analysis would require either: expansion of the comparable universe to adjacent sectors with documented methodological justification; application of alternative methods (discounted cash flow, sum-of-the-parts) using company-specific operational data; or identification of additional same-stage peers with sufficient similarity. The $2.5B in historical capital raised provides a floor reference but does not independently establish enterprise value post-public transition.
